author: NETWORG
name: Power Platform: Code App Flow
description: Adds a Power Apps (V2) triggered cloud flow to a code app offline, from the flow definition in solution source: typed model and service with Run(), the logicflows schema, dataSourcesInfo entry and power.config.json connection reference (same output as 'pa app add flow').

FlowSolutionPath.description: Path to the solution project that contains the flow, relative to the code app folder (e.g. ../Solutions.Logic)

FlowName.description: Flow file name in Workflows without the -GUID suffix (e.g. contoso_myflow for Workflows/contoso_myflow-<GUID>.json)
